info.title: Cloud-Ready School Management ERP API - Phase 1
info.description: Complete RESTful API specifications for Multi-Campus School Management ERP. Encompasses Institute Management, Multi-Campus Branches, Academic Years & Terms, Spatie Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), Global Settings, Classes, Sections, Streams, Houses, Subjects, Employee & Staff Management, and Student Admissions & Profiles.
